description:
Generate and download a traceability report (Fiche de traçabilité / Fiche Parcellaire) for the cultivable zone named 'Les Groies'.

1. Navigate to the 'Reports' (Rapports) or 'Production' section in Ekylibre.
2. Locate the report tool for Field Traceability (Fiche de traçabilité).
3. Select the zone 'Les Groies' and the current campaign (e.g., 2023 or 2024).
4. Generate/Print the report and download it as a PDF file to your Downloads folder.
